FLAGS=-ldflags -w -trimpath

run::
	go run main.go serve

badge-api::
	go build -o badge-api $(FLAGS) main.go

mocks::
	go tool mockery --all --case underscore
# Copyright 2025 Zentrum für Digitale Souveränität der Öffentlichen Verwaltung (ZenDiS) GmbH.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

services:
  postgresql:
    image: postgres:17.9-alpine3.23@sha256:c7526c0f6c3f30260a563d7bcf8ad778effac59a44f8ffa86678c35418338609
    # If you want to build the image locally, uncomment the following lines
    #build:
    #  context: .
    #  dockerfile: Dockerfile.postgres
    env_file: .env
    ports:
    - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
    - postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    env_file: .env

  cache:
    image: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.31-alpine3.24-perl@sha256:7299bc3670be3d75a41d198a0d67130abc5c76207d35d86b63d6269ea3fe7949
    container_name: cache
    volumes:
    - ./dev/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    - ./dev/nginx-cache:/opt/cache:rw
    ports:
    - "8081:8081"
    - "8082:8082"

volumes:
  postgres:POSTGRES_USER=badge-api
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=badge-api
POSTGRES_DB=badge-api
POSTGRES_HOST=localhost
POSTGRES_PORT=5432

DEVGUARD_FRONTEND="https://main.devguard.org"
DEVGUARD_BACKEND="https://api.main.devguard.org"
gitClients:
  - baseUrl: https://gitlab.opencode.de
    tokenFile: secrets/glpat.secret
    type: gitlab
    maxRequestsPerSecond: 10
  - baseUrl: https://gitlab.dev.o4oe.de
    tokenFile: secrets/glpat-dev.secret
    type: gitlab
    maxRequestsPerSecond: 10
  - baseUrl: https://github.com
    tokenFile: secrets/ghpat.secret
    type: github
    maxRequestsPerSecond: 10
# we are currently using the badge-api main ci image in the gitlab ci. Thus we should use the main config as well.
remoteConfigURL: https://gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-config/-/raw/main/.badge-api.yaml
subsequentUseApiDomain: https://software.opencode.de// Copyright 2025 Zentrum für Digitale Souveränität der Öffentlichen Verwaltung (ZenDiS) GmbH.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

package main

import (
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"

	"github.com/joho/godotenv"
	"gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-api/cmd"
)

func main() {
	// read environment variables from .env file
	// and set them as env variables.
	godotenv.Load() // nolint:errcheck

	if os.Getenv("ENABLE_PROFILING") == "true" {
		f, err := os.Create("cpu.prof")
		if err != nil {
			panic("could not create CPU profile")
		}
		defer f.Close()

		if err := pprof.StartCPUProfile(f); err != nil {
			panic("could not start cpu profile")
		}
		defer pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	}

	cmd.Execute()
}
